title: From Relevance to Utility: Rubric Alignment in Yuanbao Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.22503v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic search demands that a search engine move beyond per document relevance ranking to assemble document sets optimized for downstream LLM reasoning. Prior work addresses this either by improving individual pipeline stages in isolation or by applying RL based selection on top of relevance trained upstream modules, leaving the full stack unaligned to utility for reasoning. We propose rubric aligned search, a framework that unifies the traditional search pipeline under a single supervision surface. For each query, we derive a rubric from coarse to fine, specifying weighted positive criteria that the document set must satisfy and negative criteria that it must avoid. From this rubric we derive two training signals. First, a lightweight labeler distills rubric grounded judgments into per document utility labels, which supervise a contrastive dual encoder for retrieval and a multi task ranker trained with four rubric aligned scoring heads.

translated_title: 从相关性到效用：元宝搜索中的量规对齐
translated_abstract: 智能体搜索要求搜索引擎超越单个文档的相关性排序，转而构建为下游LLM推理优化的文档集合。先前的工作要么通过孤立地改进各个流水线阶段来解决这一问题，要么在经过相关性训练的上游模块之上应用基于强化学习的选择方法，导致整个技术栈未能对齐到面向推理的效用。我们提出“量规对齐搜索”，这是一个在单一监督面下统一传统搜索流水线的框架。对于每个查询，我们从粗到细地构建一个量规，明确规定文档集合必须满足的加权正向标准以及必须避免的负面标准。从这个量规中，我们推导出两个训练信号。首先，一个轻量级标注器将基于量规的判断蒸馏为逐文档效用标签，这些标签用于监督用于检索的对比式双编码器，以及一个通过四个量规对齐评分头训练的多任务排序器。
tldr: 该论文提出“量规对齐搜索”框架，通过为每个查询构建从粗到细、包含加权正向与负面标准的量规，将整个搜索流水线统一对齐到面向LLM推理的文档集合效用，而非传统的单文档相关性排序。
